logomark: Seven square cells on a 3 × 3 grid, with a lime Core cell.

usage.svg/hosty-mark-dark.svg: White grid (transparent) and lime Core for dark backgrounds.
usage.svg/hosty-icon-brand.svg: Ink tile, white grid and lime Core; retained filename.
usage.svg/hosty-icon-light.svg: Ink tile, white grid and lime Core; light-theme alias.
usage.svg/hosty-icon-dark.svg: Ink tile, white grid and lime Core; baked dark-theme alias.
usage.svg/hosty-favicon.svg: Theme-aware transparent grid, scaled 1.16, with the Core cell always lime.
usage.svg/hosty-logo-horizontal-*.svg: Mark + Hosty wordmark lockup (light / dark / on-white).
usage.icons/light: PNG ink marks (transparent) for light backgrounds.
usage.icons/dark: PNG white grid (transparent) with lime Core for dark backgrounds.
